title: tc-chat-history
description: The conversation list: search, pinning, folders, rename and delete with Undo, grouped by date; windowed.

folders.description: Folders, in the order they show; chats name theirs with `folder`

now.description: "Now" for the date groups (epoch ms or a Date). Unset: the time the element was connected

heading.description: The heading, and the tree's name

maxHeight.description: Height of the list before it scrolls, in px

undoFor.description: How long Undo stays after a delete, in ms. It waits while the pointer or focus is on it and starts over after; `Infinity` keeps it until the next delete (WCAG 2.2.1)

hints.description: Show the keyboard hints (hints="false" hides them)

locale.description: Locale for the month names; unset uses the page's

context.description: What's loaded into the current chat as context – summary items from earlier chats. The app decides what's sent

updatedAt.description: Last activity: epoch ms, an ISO string or a Date

folder.description: The id of the folder it's in

summary.description: The session's structured summary – findings, open questions, next steps – which can be loaded as context

kind.description: What kind of item, e.g. "Finding", "Open question", "Next step"

ChatSummaryItem.description: One part of a session's structured summary

kind.description: What kind of item, e.g. "Finding", "Open question", "Next step"

ChatContextItem.description: A summary item loaded into the current chat, with the id of the chat it came from
